description: 1. Agent must locate and read three files: price_score_formula.txt (the IFERROR/ROUND/IF/MAX/ABS formula), bid_opening_record.txt (5 vendor bids), and evaluation_task.txt (output requirements). 2. Compute benchmark price by excluding the single highest (V005=534.80) and lowest (V004=389.00) bids, then averaging the remaining three: (498.50+521.00+476.20)/3 ≈ 498.5667. 3. Apply the formula =IFERROR(ROUND(IF(B2<E2,MAX(0,F2-ABS(B2-E2)/E2*100*0.6),IF(B2=E2,F2,MAX(0,F2-ABS(B2-E2)/E2*100*0.9))),2),0) to all 5 vendors. CRITICAL TRAP 1: bids BELOW benchmark use coefficient 0.6 (not 0.9), bids ABOVE benchmark use 0.9 — agents relying on intuition often swap these. CRITICAL TRAP 2: the denominator is always E2 (benchmark price), not B2 (bid price) — the distractor file explicitly shows the 'old wrong formula' that uses bid price as denominator. 4. Expected scores: V001≈29.99, V002≈25.95, V003≈27.31, V004≈16.81, V005≈23.46. 5. Record intermediate calculation steps per the 6-step SOP (inner-to-outer). 6. Boundary analysis must flag IFERROR (zero denominator guard) and MAX(0,...) negative score prevention. 7. Output all findings to price_score_report.json with the required top-level keys.
